whenToUse: Short single choice lists in forms and settings, such as density, visibility, role or release channel
Option tiles and divided card rows for shipping speed, contact method, language or a teammate
Checkout and plan steps that pick one saved payment method or one priced subscription tier

whenNotToUse.when: A list where any number of the options can be ticked together
A whole modal step built around one choice, such as a template or a sync scope
A full plan table with billing period tabs and a feature list per tier

agentNotes: Every example seeds `RadioGroup` through `defaultValue` and reads nothing back; pass a controlled value and a change handler to act on the pick
No example sets a name on `RadioGroup`, so a native form post carries no choice; add one when the group lives in a form
Every `RadioGroupItem` `id` is a fixed string such as r1 or an option value; derive unique ids when a group can render twice on one page
